name: The companion leads the way
body: Dean's play-test (2026-11-16): it is easy to get ahead of her, she only follows when the player is within range, and she should lead. She now waits at a stop only until the player is near, walks on to the next stop when they are, and when the player is far behind she walks back a little to nudge them on; if the player is ahead of her she hurries to catch up instead of waiting to be reached. She is guiding, not following. The boost stop still holds her until used, and every puzzle stays solvable alone.

comments.text: Filed before any code, from Dean's play-test feedback of 2026-11-16.

Built: wider lead range, hurrying when the player runs past, pausing and nudging (a hop) when they lag, `near` per stop. Decisions D-090 and D-091. Test: `engine/tests/host/the-companion-leads-the-way`. Not run in the cloud (no nox); feel is for Dean to tune (`LEAD_RANGE`, `PAUSE_DISTANCE` in game-entities/companion.nyx). Stays in-progress until the PR merges.

plan: 1. Companion gets the level's anchors and a swing leg. 2. Lead range, hurry, pause and nudge. 3. World files, docs, decisions, tests.
acceptance_criteria: She walks on ahead of the player along the route
She waits when the player lags and gives a nudge toward the player
A player who runs ahead does not strand her
Boost and swing stops still hold her until done
